savollar.q: The music is very quiet. Can you ___ the volume?
savollar.izoh: Ovozni balandlatish — turn up; pasaytirish — turn down.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: I looked it for in the kitchen.
I looked for it in the kitchen.
I looked for in the kitchen it.
I for looked it in the kitchen.
savollar.izoh: `look for` AJRALMAYDI: olmosh ham oxirida qoladi — look for it.

savollar.q: Find the mistake: 'She did a big mistake in the exam.'
savollar.izoh: `make a mistake` bo'ladi: «She made a big mistake».

savollar.q: Every morning my sister ___ her bed before breakfast.
savollar.izoh: «Karavotni yig'ishtirmoq» — make the bed.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: Put on it, it is cold.
Put it on, it is cold.
It put on, it is cold.
savollar.izoh: Ajraladigan iborada olmosh o'rtada: put **it** on.

savollar.q: My phone battery is empty. Where can I ___ the charger?
savollar.izoh: Rozetkaga ulash — plug in.

savollar.q: Find the mistake: 'Please close the computer, we are going home.'
savollar.izoh: Texnika `turn off` yoki `shut down` bilan o'chiriladi, `close` bilan emas.

savollar.q: She ___ friends very easily at her new school.
savollar.izoh: Do'st orttirmoq — make friends.

savollar.q: We are almost home. Let's ___ at the next corner.
savollar.izoh: Transportdan tushish — get off; chiqish — get on.

savollar.q: 'Look after' iborasi o'zbekchada nimani anglatadi?
savollar.izoh: `look after` — qaramoq; `look for` — qidirmoq.

savollar.q: It is dark in here. Can you ___ the light, please?
savollar.izoh: Chiroq «yoqiladi» — turn on. «Open the light» o'zbekcha «chiroqni ochmoq» dan ko'chgan xato.

savollar.q: The film is finished. Please ___ the TV and go to bed.
savollar.izoh: Televizor «o'chiriladi» — turn off. «Close the TV» xato.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: The radio is loud. Turn it off.
The radio is loud. Turn off it.
The radio is loud. Turn off he.
The radio is loud. It turn off.
savollar.izoh: Olmosh bilan ikki so'z AJRALADI: turn **it** off. «Turn off it» degan shakl yo'q.

savollar.q: I can't come out tonight — I have to ___ my homework.
savollar.izoh: Uy vazifasi bilan doim `do`: do homework. «make homework» xato (atlas #51).

savollar.q: Be careful with the numbers. It is easy to ___ a mistake here.
savollar.izoh: Xato «qilinadi» degan bo'lsa ham, ingliz tilida `make a mistake`.

savollar.q: It is cold outside. ___ your warm clothes before you go.
savollar.izoh: Kiyim «kiyiladi» — put on. Uning teskarisi — take off.

savollar.q: I can't find my keys. Can you help me ___ them?
savollar.izoh: «Qidirmoq» — look **for**. `look after` = qaramoq, `look at` = qaramoq (nazar solmoq).

savollar.q: My alarm rings at six, but I only ___ at half past six.
savollar.izoh: `wake up` — uyg'onmoq, `get up` — o'rindan turmoq. Bu yerda turish haqida.

savollar.q: Find the mistake: 'She opened the radio and listened to music.'
savollar.izoh: `open` o'rniga `turned on` kerak — atlas #54 dagi eng barqaror xato.

savollar.q: The teacher said a new word, so I ___ in my notebook.
savollar.izoh: Olmosh o'rtaga tushadi: write **it** down.

savollar.q: The neighbours ___ a lot of noise every night.
savollar.izoh: Shovqin «qilinadi» — make a noise.

savollar.q: Qaysi gap XATO?
savollar.izoh: Ajraladigan iborada ot bilan ikki tartib ham to'g'ri, olmosh bilan esa faqat o'rtada: «take them off».

savollar.q: He wants to ___ smoking, because it is bad for his health.
savollar.izoh: Tashlamoq, voz kechmoq — give up.

savollar.q: Nobody knew the answer, so we ___ on the internet.
savollar.izoh: Bilib olmoq, aniqlamoq — find out.

savollar.q: She has to ___ her little brother while her parents are at work.
savollar.izoh: Qaramoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq — look **after**.

savollar.q: This old newspaper is useless. Please ___ it ___.
savollar.izoh: Tashlab yubormoq — throw away. Olmosh o'rtada: throw **it** away.

savollar.q: I want to ___ this shirt before I buy it.
savollar.izoh: Kiyib ko'rmoq — try on.

savollar.q: My father ___ the shopping every Saturday morning.
savollar.izoh: do the shopping — «xarid qilmoq».

savollar.q: Can you ___ a photo of us, please?
savollar.izoh: Rasmga olish — take a photo. `do` ham, `make` ham emas: o'zbekchada «surat OLMOQ».

savollar.q: The room is dirty. We must ___ before the guests come.
savollar.izoh: Yig'ishtirmoq, tozalamoq — clean up. `look up` = lug'atdan qidirmoq.

savollar.q: It is too loud in here. Can you ___ the music a little?
savollar.izoh: Pasaytirmoq — turn down. `turn off` butunlay o'chirish bo'lardi.

savollar.q: Please ___ this form with your name and address.
savollar.izoh: Blankani to'ldirmoq — fill in.

savollar.q: I always ___ my best in the English lesson.
savollar.izoh: do one's best — «bor kuchini qilmoq».

savollar.q: He was tired, so he ___ on the sofa and closed his eyes.
savollar.izoh: O'tirmoq — sit down; turmoq — stand up.

savollar.q: Your bag is on the floor. Please ___ ___.
savollar.izoh: Ko'tarmoq — pick up. Ajraladigan ibora, shuning uchun olmosh o'rtada.

savollar.q: My computer is very slow today. I will ___ it ___ and start again.
savollar.izoh: O'chirib qayta yoqish — turn it off. Olmosh o'rtada.

savollar.q: Don't forget to ___ the lights ___ when you leave the room.
savollar.izoh: turn the lights off — ot bilan bu tartib ham to'g'ri.

savollar.q: 'Wake up' iborasi o'zbekchada nimani anglatadi?
savollar.izoh: `wake up` — uyg'onmoq; `get up` — o'rindan turmoq. Ikkalasi boshqa-boshqa.

savollar.q: I ___ a phone call to my grandmother every Sunday.
savollar.izoh: make a phone call — «qo'ng'iroq qilmoq».

savollar.q: The room is dark. Where is the ___ for the light?
savollar.izoh: O'chirgich (vyklyuchatel) — switch.

savollar.q: My brother ___ the washing up when it is his turn.
savollar.izoh: do the washing up — «idish yuvmoq». Ega 3-shaxs, shuning uchun `does`.

savollar.q: He ___ his glasses ___ and cleaned them.
savollar.izoh: Yechmoq — take off.

savollar.q: The meeting is important, so we must ___ a decision today.
savollar.izoh: make a decision — «qaror qabul qilmoq».

savollar.q: She ___ the address ___ so that she could remember it.
savollar.izoh: Yozib olmoq — write down. Olmosh bo'lmagani uchun ot ikki so'z orasida tura oladi.

savollar.q: I have a lot of housework to ___ this evening.
savollar.izoh: do the housework — uy ishlari `do` bilan.

savollar.q: The lamp does not work. Is the ___ in the socket?
savollar.izoh: Vilka (shtepsel) — plug; rozetka (quvvat uyasi) — socket.

savollar.q: 'Give up' iborasi o'zbekchada nimani anglatadi?
savollar.izoh: `give up` — voz kechmoq. Ikki so'zning alohida ma'nosidan chiqmaydi.

savollar.q: Find the mistake: 'He made his homework and went out.'
savollar.izoh: `do homework` bo'ladi: «He did his homework».

savollar.q: The film is too quiet. Where is the ___?
savollar.izoh: Pult — remote.

savollar.q: My uncle ___ a lot of money last year.
savollar.izoh: make money — «pul topmoq».

savollar.q: The children ___ at seven and had breakfast at half past seven.
savollar.izoh: O'rindan turmoq — get up.

savollar.q: Qaysi gap XATO?
v: Can you turn on the radio?
Can you turn the radio off?
savollar.izoh: «turn on it» degan shakl yo'q — olmosh ikki so'zning orasiga tushadi.
